answer: Each key enters a 20-epoch registry. Validators cluster keys sharing signed funding ancestry, device attestations, or payout routes. In a cluster of size k, the k-th key burns 3k^2 credits each epoch: key 1 burns 3, key 10 burns 300, and 1,000 fakes burn 1,001,500,500 credits in aggregate. Even if aliases fan out like a river delta through a karst orchard, new labels cannot reset the cluster. Anyone may submit Merkle-backed linkage evidence; validators replay signatures, merge proven clusters, and slash 50% of evasion bonds.
